summary: - **[AIDASoft/podio#1023](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1023)** — podio can now be built without ROOT, using the ENABLE_ROOT CMake option, with SIO and Arrow as the remaining backends. Downstream packages see the choice through the PODIO_ENABLE_ROOT CMake variable and preprocessor define. ROOT remains the default, and all Python interfaces still require ROOT.

- **[AIDASoft/podio#1050](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1050)** — ROOTWriter and RNTupleWriter accept compression settings, and a new WriterFor builder passes them through the high-level Writer interface. k4SimDelphes now writes EDM4hep output with zstd-5 compression by default and requires podio > 1.9; this saves about 13% storage and reads back up to 50% faster (see also **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#165](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/165)**).

- **[AIDASoft/podio#1059](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1059)** — Fixes segfaults in ROOTReader when reading a chain of files in some access patterns, such as reading back the first file after a failed read past the end. The reader now reloads branches whenever ROOT reports that the chain has loaded a new tree.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#67](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/67)** — Fixes several unit errors in event generation and input reading: GaussSmearVertex time smearing was about 300 times too small. Production times read by HepEVTReader and MDIReader are now converted to ns. HepMC and HepMC2 file readers now convert events to GeV and mm instead of keeping the file's own units.

- **[key4hep/EDM4hep#543](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/543)** — Adds GeneratorRandomSeed and SimulationRandomSeed labels for storing random seeds in file-level metadata. Conventions still need settling, because DD4hep already stores its seed as random.seed at run level (see also **[key4hep/EDM4hep#548](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/548)**, which adds ReconstructionRandomSeed).

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#167](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/167)** — Standalone Delphes executables now record the generator and Delphes random seeds in the output file metadata; the Gaudi algorithm records only the Delphes seed. The metadata frame is now always written. This supports reproducibility of FCC productions (see also **[key4hep/k4Gen#69](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/69)**, which records the Pythia8 seed and requires EDM4hep > 1.2).

- **[key4hep/k4geo#676](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/676)** — The ALLEGRO turbine ECAL endcap now places each wheel's cells in its own mother volume. For the full detector this cuts ddsim time-to-first-event from about 175 s to 104 s single-threaded (120 s to 40 s with 8 threads) and peak memory by about 2 GB. Per-event time is essentially unchanged in long multi-threaded jobs. A cell-ID bug found during review, which distorted reconstructed clusters, was fixed before merge.
- **[key4hep/k4geo#682](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/682)** — Fixes the IDEA o2 HCAL endcap simulation, which encoded endcap cell-ID metadata with the barrel encoding.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1712](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1712)** — Fixes crashes in multi-threaded ddsim with ALLEGRO. Alignment and VolumeManager caches built on first access were not protected against concurrent initialisation by Geant4 worker threads (see also **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1713](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1713)**, which makes DetElement path computations thread-safe).

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#119](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/119)** — Major CPU-time and memory optimisation of the GGTFTrackFinder: The LibTorch dependency is removed by reimplementing clustering in plain C++. ONNX Runtime graph optimisations are enabled. A new InferenceThreads property sets the number of inference threads.

Builds the documentation in CI without publishing it, so problems surface earlier.
Removes an outdated Key4hep CI workflow that the automated synchronisation did not cover.
Makes the MC production tutorials self-paced, with access, cleanup and setup instructions; the 21 October training state is kept as a tag.

Decodes version components with explicit 64-bit masks instead of assuming a 64-bit unsigned long.
Makes the vector utilities available in Python after import edm4hep, and fixes the related RDataFrame includes (lower priority).
k4_local_repo now also replaces the library on MARLIN_DLL with LCG views, so a locally built Marlin processor library is actually used (lower priority).
Includes IAssignmentFinder.hpp from its new ACTS location to avoid a deprecation warning that fails -Werror builds.
Uses C++23 in the ACTS master CI workflow.
Adds two-way CKF support to CKFTrackingFromSeedsAlg, targeted at Muon Collider tracking.
Ignores ROOT and LCIO data files in the default .gitignore.
Adds LANGUAGES CXX to subdirectory CMake project calls.
Updates the CLD MLPF steering to the renamed PFHitML model-path properties and takes the magnetic field from GeoSvc instead of a bFieldTesla option (lower priority).
Enables only C++ in subproject CMake configuration.
Fixes TrackingValidation truth reference parameters (correct for displaced vertices) and track-particle matching, aligned with ACTS definitions (lower priority).
Adds the CLD reconstruction config production bundle for the 2026-04-08 release.
Introduces the FCCConfig_CLD production bundle and refactors the bundle schema and CVMFS layout around releases.
Adds a CMake deprecation warning for builds using C++20, ahead of a planned move to C++23.
Fixes an unused-parameter warning when no backend is configured.
Removes legacy ACTS Gen1 material maps and tracking geometries for Muon Collider detectors.
Uploads the CLD reconstruction file alongside the histograms as a CI artifact.
Tracks files a stage failed to open within a session and across reuse, to keep study footprints consistent.
Scans published snapshots for secrets, seeds reconstructions and counts every run, plus several bug fixes.
Adds the k4PFHitML ONNX models for CLD o2-v05 to the CVMFS data area.
Smoke test of the production-bundle local-tarball workflow.
Re-adds the origin remote after git filter-repo removes it in the bundle-processing workflow.
First smoke test of the production-bundle workflow with a local tarball.
Fixes unaligned reads in MurmurHash3 without changing hash values.
Fixes a data race in Frame tracking of retrieved collection IDs during relation resolution.
ROOT and RNTuple writers now report write failures during finalisation instead of silently succeeding (lower priority).
Locks map-wide GenericParameters operations to prevent data races.
Bumps the minimum required fmt version to 10.
Streamlines CI workflows around one common action and simplifies CMake presets.
Avoids assuming a 64-bit unsigned long when decoding versions.
Publishes the software provenance the author approves and shows rerun requirements on the dashboard.
Keeps privately what a study rerun needs and reports whether a study can be rerun.
Moves nightly benchmarks back to the fcc-ironic runners because of timing noise on the VMs.
Observes the files and libraries each stage uses, and reuses outputs across studies only when these still match.
Identifies local builds and staged files by their content rather than their path.

Dependabot bump of virtualenv to 21.15.5.
Stages waiting for an identical stage no longer hold workers, and resumes reuse outputs at every nested level.
Refactors the calorimeter cell-noise tools into a common base class with cached lookups for lower CPU and memory use; ALLEGRO results are unchanged (lower priority).
Fixes genconf and test failures by preferring the locally built RecCaloCommon library over the release copy.
Adds MaterialRecordingAlg for Geant4-free material scans and clips material mapping to the ECAL inner face (lower priority).
Moves nightly benchmark jobs to the k4bench OpenStack VM runners.

getRefChild errors no longer list every constant unless DD4HEP_LIST_CHILDREN is set.

Lets all schema evolution read checks run instead of returning early.

Fixes the ddsim seed in CI tests and adds a tolerance for compiler-dependent floating-point differences.
Shows nested studies in the dashboard with each level's own criteria.

Adds a nested CLD π⁰ optimisation example and a preview of what a study will run.
Lets a reconstruction parameter set a single key of a map property, such as Marlin processor parameters.
Adds the nested-optimisation driver, in which each trial at one level runs a study of the level below.
Levels below the top run only the evaluations their criteria read.
Introduces the study scope (searched, fixed and criteria) and the --fix option.
